WITH source_data AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        updated_at,
        approval_status,
        business_id,
        business_name,
        created_at,
        deleted,
        industry_type,
        name,
        salt,
        timezone,
        timezone_switch_at
    FROM raw.account_history
),

cleaned_data AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        updated_at,
        approval_status,
        business_id,
        business_name,
        created_at,
        deleted,
        industry_type,
        name,
        salt,
        -- Apply timezone validation and cleaning
        CASE
            WHEN timezone IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN timezone IN ('America/Los_Angeles', 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London', 'Europe/Paris', 'Asia/Singapore', 'Asia/Shanghai', 'America/Chicago', 'Europe/Berlin', 'Australia/Sydney') THEN timezone
            WHEN NOT REGEXP_MATCHES(timezone, '^[A-Z][a-z]+/[A-Z][a-z_]+$') THEN NULL
            ELSE timezone
        END AS timezone,
        timezone_switch_at
    FROM source_data
    WHERE timezone IS NOT NULL -- Remove rows with invalid timezone after validation
)

SELECT
    id,
    updated_at,
    approval_status,
    business_id,
    business_name,
    created_at,
    deleted,
    industry_type,
    name,
    salt,
    timezone,
    timezone_switch_at
FROM cleaned_data

-- Twitter user history staging table
-- Applies data validation and cleaning rules

WITH source_data AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        _fivetran_synced,
        screen_name,
        url,
        created_at,
        followers_count,
        friends_count,
        listed_count,
        favourites_count,
        statuses_count,
        verified,
        CASE WHEN protected_user = TRUE THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS protected,
        default_profile,
        default_profile_image,
        location,
        description,
        time_zone,
        lang
    FROM raw.twitter_user_history
),

cleaned_data AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        _fivetran_synced,
        -- Apply screen_name validation and cleaning
        CASE
            WHEN screen_name IS NULL OR TRIM(screen_name) = '' THEN NULL
            WHEN REGEXP_MATCHES(screen_name, '^[A-Za-z0-9_]{3,15}$') THEN screen_name
            ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(screen_name, '[^A-Za-z0-9_]', '')
        END AS screen_name,
        -- Apply URL validation and cleaning
        CASE
            WHEN url IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN REGEXP_MATCHES(url, '^https?://[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}(/.*)?') THEN url
            WHEN REGEXP_MATCHES(url, '^(https?://)?[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}(/.*)?') THEN 'https://' || REGEXP_REPLACE(url, '^https?://', '')
            ELSE NULL
        END AS url,
        created_at,
        followers_count,
        friends_count AS following_count,
        listed_count,
        favourites_count,
        statuses_count,
        verified,
        protected,
        default_profile,
        default_profile_image,
        location,
        description,
        time_zone,
        lang
    FROM source_data
    WHERE screen_name IS NOT NULL -- Remove invalid entries
    AND NOT REGEXP_MATCHES(screen_name, '[!@#$%^&*()+=<>?}{|,]') -- Remove rows with harmful characters
)

SELECT *
FROM cleaned_data

-- Staging table for xero journal data with validation rules applied

WITH raw_data AS (
    SELECT
        journal_id,
        created_date_utc,
        journal_date,
        journal_number,
        reference,
        source_id,
        source_type
    FROM raw.xero_journal_data
),

cleaned_data AS (
    SELECT
        journal_id,
        created_date_utc,
        journal_date,

        -- Apply validation rules for journal_number
        CASE
            -- Check if journal_number contains alphabetic characters or special chars
            WHEN journal_number ~ '[A-Za-z]' OR journal_number ~ '[!@#$%^&*()]'
            THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(journal_number, '[A-Za-z!@#$%^&*()]', '', 'g')
            -- Check if journal_number is NULL, empty, or invalid
            WHEN journal_number IS NULL OR TRIM(journal_number) = '' OR journal_number LIKE 'INVALID%'
                 OR journal_number LIKE 'BAD%'
            THEN NULL
            -- Try to extract only numeric part if mixed content
            WHEN journal_number ~ '\d+'
            THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(journal_number, '[^0-9]', '', 'g')
            -- Range check: ensure reasonable journal number range
            WHEN REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(journal_number, ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g')::INT > 9999999
            THEN NULL
            ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(journal_number, ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g')
        END AS journal_number,

        reference,
        source_id,
        source_type,
        TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-17 11:30:22.865253+08:00' AS processed_at

    FROM raw_data
)

SELECT
    journal_id,
    created_date_utc,
    journal_date,
    journal_number::INT AS journal_number,
    reference,
    source_id,
    source_type,
    processed_at
FROM cleaned_data
WHERE journal_id IS NOT NULL

-- Mart table: Invoice Line Items - enriched with invoice-level metrics and defensible constraints
-- Layer contract: ONLY reference intermediate layer

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        ili.line_item_id,
        ili.invoice_id,
        ili.account_code,
        ili.account_name,
        ili.account_type,
        ili.account_class,
        ili.description,
        ili.quantity,
        ili.unit_amount,
        ili.line_amount,
        ili.tax_amount,
        ili.tax_type,
        ili.discount_rate,
        ili.contact_id,
        ili.contact_name,
        ili.region,
        ili.department,
        ili.project,
        ili.location,
        ili.class,
        ili.customer,
        ili.cost_center,
        ili.processed_at
    FROM intermediate.int_xero__invoice_line_items_enriched ili
    WHERE ili.line_item_id IS NOT NULL
      AND ili.invoice_id IS NOT NULL
),

validated AS (
    SELECT
        b.*,
        -- Enforce non-negative amounts for metric denominators; keep raw for audit
        GREATEST(b.line_amount, 0) AS line_amount_nonneg,
        GREATEST(b.tax_amount, 0)  AS tax_amount_nonneg,
        -- Net of tax (non-negative)
        GREATEST(b.line_amount - COALESCE(b.tax_amount, 0), 0) AS line_net_of_tax,
        -- Guard quantity
        CASE WHEN b.quantity IS NULL OR b.quantity < 0 THEN NULL ELSE b.quantity END AS quantity_valid
    FROM base b
),

invoice_sums AS (
    SELECT
        invoice_id,
        SUM(line_amount_nonneg) AS invoice_gross_nonneg,
        SUM(line_net_of_tax)    AS invoice_net_nonneg,
        COUNT(*)                AS invoice_line_count
    FROM validated
    GROUP BY invoice_id
),

scored AS (
    SELECT
        v.*,
        s.invoice_gross_nonneg,
        s.invoice_net_nonneg,
        s.invoice_line_count,
        -- Line share of invoice totals (defensive denominators)
        CASE WHEN s.invoice_gross_nonneg > 0 THEN v.line_amount_nonneg / s.invoice_gross_nonneg END AS line_share_gross,
        CASE WHEN s.invoice_net_nonneg   > 0 THEN v.line_net_of_tax   / s.invoice_net_nonneg   END AS line_share_net,
        -- Window metrics per invoice
        SUM(v.line_amount_nonneg) OVER (PARTITION BY v.invoice_id ORDER BY v.line_item_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS invoice_cum_gross_nonneg,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY v.invoice_id ORDER BY v.line_item_id) AS line_seq_in_invoice,
        -- Classification
        CASE
            WHEN v.line_amount > 0 THEN 'Revenue'
            WHEN v.line_amount < 0 THEN 'Expense/Refund'
            ELSE 'Neutral'
        END AS line_item_type
    FROM validated v
    JOIN invoice_sums s USING (invoice_id)
)

SELECT
    -- Identity
    line_item_id,
    invoice_id,

    -- Details
    account_code,
    account_name,
    account_type,
    account_class,
    description,
    quantity_valid AS quantity,
    unit_amount,
    line_amount,
    tax_amount,
    tax_type,
    discount_rate,

    -- Contact
    contact_id,
    contact_name,

    -- Tracking dims
    region,
    department,
    project,
    location,
    class,
    customer,
    cost_center,

    -- Metrics
    line_amount_nonneg,
    tax_amount_nonneg,
    line_net_of_tax,
    invoice_gross_nonneg,
    invoice_net_nonneg,
    invoice_line_count,
    line_share_gross,
    line_share_net,
    invoice_cum_gross_nonneg,
    line_seq_in_invoice,
    line_item_type,

    -- Processing metadata
    processed_at,
    TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-17 11:30:25.511140+08:00' AS report_generated_at

FROM scored

ORDER BY invoice_id, line_seq_in_invoice

-- Mart table: Profit and Loss Report - show income and expenses over time

WITH general_ledger AS (
    SELECT
        journal_date,
        account_code,
        account_name,
        account_type,
        account_class,
        net_amount,

        CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(journal_date AS DATE)) AS INT) AS fiscal_year,
        CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(journal_date AS DATE)) AS INT) AS fiscal_month,
        EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM CAST(journal_date AS DATE)) AS fiscal_quarter,

        region,
        department,
        project,
        customer
    FROM intermediate.int_xero__general_ledger_fact
),

profit_and_loss_data AS (
    SELECT
        journal_date,
        fiscal_year,
        fiscal_month,
        fiscal_quarter,
        account_code,
        account_name,
        account_type,
        account_class,

        -- Split out revenue and expenses (and other account types)
        CASE
            WHEN account_class = 'REVENUE' THEN net_amount
            ELSE 0
        END AS revenue_amount,

        CASE
            WHEN account_class = 'EXPENSE' THEN ABS(net_amount)  -- Make positive for expenses
            ELSE 0
        END AS expense_amount,

        net_amount AS net_amount,

        -- P&L classification
        CASE
            WHEN account_class = 'REVENUE' THEN 'Revenue'
            WHEN account_class = 'EXPENSE' THEN 'Expenses'
            WHEN account_class IN ('ASSET', 'LIABILITY', 'EQUITY') THEN 'Balance Sheet'
            ELSE 'Other'
        END AS pl_category,

        -- Detailed classification
        CASE
            WHEN account_type = 'REVENUE' THEN 'Operating Revenue'
            WHEN account_type = 'EXPENSE' AND CAST(account_code AS VARCHAR) LIKE '4%' THEN 'Operating Expenses'
            WHEN account_type = 'EXPENSE' AND CAST(account_code AS VARCHAR) LIKE '6%' THEN 'Administrative Expenses'
            WHEN account_type = 'DIRECTCOSTS' THEN 'Cost of Goods Sold'
            WHEN account_type = 'OVERHEADS' THEN 'Overhead'
            WHEN account_type = 'DEPRECIATN' THEN 'Depreciation'
            ELSE 'Other'
        END AS pl_subcategory,

        region,
        department,
        project,
        customer

    FROM general_ledger
),

-- Aggregate by different time periods and dimensions
monthly_summary AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(journal_date AS DATE)) AS report_month,
        fiscal_year,
        fiscal_month,
        fiscal_quarter,
        account_code,
        account_name,
        pl_category,
        pl_subcategory,
        region,
        department,
        project,

        SUM(revenue_amount) AS monthly_revenue,
        SUM(expense_amount) AS monthly_expenses,
        SUM(net_amount) AS monthly_net

    FROM profit_and_loss_data
    GROUP BY
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(journal_date AS DATE)),
        fiscal_year,
        fiscal_month,
        fiscal_quarter,
        account_code,
        account_name,
        pl_category,
        pl_subcategory,
        region,
        department,
        project
),

quarterly_summary AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', report_month) AS report_quarter,
        fiscal_year,
        fiscal_quarter,
        pl_category,
        pl_subcategory,
        region,
        department,
        project,

        SUM(monthly_revenue) AS quarterly_revenue,
        SUM(monthly_expenses) AS quarterly_expenses,
        SUM(monthly_net) AS quarterly_net

    FROM monthly_summary
    GROUP BY
        DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', report_month),
        fiscal_year,
        fiscal_quarter,
        pl_category,
        pl_subcategory,
        region,
        department,
        project
)

-- Final result with both detailed and summary views
SELECT
    report_month,
    fiscal_year,
    fiscal_month,
    'Monthly' AS period_type,
    pl_category,
    pl_subcategory,
    account_code,
    account_name,
    monthly_revenue AS revenue,
    monthly_expenses AS expenses,
    monthly_net AS net_amount,

    -- Running totals and percentages
    SUM(monthly_net) OVER (PARTITION BY report_month ORDER BY pl_category, account_code) AS cumulative_net,

    -- Tracking dimensions
    region,
    department,
    project,

    TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-17 11:30:25.438839+08:00' AS report_generated_at

FROM monthly_summary
WHERE monthly_revenue != 0 OR monthly_expenses != 0  -- Only show accounts with activity

ORDER BY
    report_month DESC,
    CASE pl_category
        WHEN 'Revenue' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Expenses' THEN 2
        ELSE 3
    END,
    account_code
